mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (name, owner_user_id, watermark_enabled, default_watermark_position, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{ownerUserId}, #{watermarkEnabled}, #{defaultWatermarkPosition}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, owner_user_id, watermark_enabled, default_watermark_position, status, created_at, updated_at FROM project WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, name, owner_user_id, watermark_enabled, default_watermark_position, status, created_at, updated_at FROM project WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE project_invite_acceptance FROM project_invite_acceptance INNER JOIN project_invite ON project_invite.id = project_invite_acceptance.invite_id WHERE project_invite.project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_member active_member WHERE active_member.project_id = p.id AND active_member.status = 'active')
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.status, p.watermark_enabled, p.default_watermark_position, m.role, owner_user.nick_name AS owner_nick_name, AS member_count FROM project_member m INNER JOIN project p ON p.id = m.project_id INNER JOIN user owner_user ON owner_user.id = p.owner_user_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'active' ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_member m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'active'

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.status, p.watermark_enabled, p.default_watermark_position, p.created_at, p.updated_at, m.role, owner_user.nick_name AS owner_nick_name, AS member_count FROM project_member m INNER JOIN project p ON p.id = m.project_id INNER JOIN user owner_user ON owner_user.id = p.owner_user_id WHERE p.id = #{projectId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'active'
